notes:
Duplicate-content advice now uses the redirect Docket already measured.

A site that serves every page over both http:// and https:// produces one
duplicate group per path. Docket reported 69 such groups on a university
department and told the reader to pick a canonical URL for each — while
reporting the missing http-to-https redirect in the same report, at HIGH.

When the scheme split explains essentially all the groups, the advice now leads
with the redirect: one server rule, no canonical tags needed. When it explains
only some of them, the per-group advice stands and the redirect is offered as a
starting point, so work with another cause is not hidden behind it.
